subject: Reminder: Upcoming Payment Due
body: Dear [Name], This is a friendly reminder that your payment for the recent purchases made on our platform is due on [Due Date]. To avoid any late fees or disruptions to your service, please ensure that the payment is processed by the due date. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. Best regards, [Company Name]
